title: Ɔkra a Ɔwɛn no wɔ Asubɔnten no ano
intro: Wɔde kokoam asɛmpatrɛw adwuma bi hyɛɛ ɔkra kumaa bi nsa, sɛ onfi akyirikyiri nhwɛ sɛnea nkrabea rekɔ so wɔ nsu no so no. Sɛ wɔanhu saa akontaabu yi na wonsusuw ho a, na bedi dwuma titiriw wɔ ɔman bi abakɔsɛm a ɛbɛsakra no mu.
clues: Me maame na ɔmaa me adwuma bi a na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ miwia me ho na mema m’ani da hɔ.
M’ani dii akokoaa ketewa bi a ɛrehuruhuruw wɔ nsu a ɛreworo so no akyi, na dadwen ayɛ me koma mu duru.
Bere a apontow bi a na menhwɛ kwan huu no, mebɛne, na ehu ahyɛ me ma.
Mihuu wɔn abasamtu wɔ ɔhwɛfo bi ho na mede ano aduru bi mae a manda nokware no adi.
Me de ne ho gyee mu wɔ bere ano no de ɔkra a ɔma ɔyare no san baa nea ohia no kɛse no nkyɛn.
Wɔ tumidifo asɛnnibea no, mekae sɛ: ‘So mɛkyerɛ wo kwan akɔ abusua bi a wɔbɛma no aduan na wɔde ahwɛyiye ahwɛ no nkyɛn?’

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
